import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import pathlib,json,urllib.request,datetime,hashlib,subprocess,concurrent.futures
p=pathlib.Path.cwd();(p/'sources').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
a=['1201.4058','1412.4100','1412.8530','1402.7257','1508.05487','1608.03951','1405.2560','1501.00176','1609.00152']
def get(k):
 u='https://arxiv.org/pdf/'+k;r={'url':u,'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'id':k}
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(u,timeout=18) as f:b=f.read();r.update(status=f.status,final_url=f.url,bytes=len(b),sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest())
  (p/'sources'/ (k+'.pdf')).write_bytes(b)
  z=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p/'sources'/(k+'.pdf')),str(p/'sources'/(k+'.txt'))],capture_output=True,timeout=15);r['converter_exit']=z.returncode
 except Exception as e:r['error']=str(e)
 return r
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as ex:r=list(ex.map(get,a))
(p/'access-primary.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(r,indent=2))
# existing original source receipts are routing data, no embedded path following
q=p.parent/'bicores-armstrong-source-review-r1';d=json.loads((q/'public-access.json').read_text());print('SEED',json.dumps(d)[:4000])

No clearance inferred.','telemetry':'native service unavailable; no fabricated HTTP/resource values'}},indent=2)+'\n')
